explanation.headline: Dabigatran etexilate mesylate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; current inventory ranges from 13.3 to 32 days on hand across sites

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows dabigatran etexilate mesylate is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 127 capsules of the 110 mg presentation at 9.5 per day for 13.3 days on hand, and 289 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 9 per day for 32 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 228 capsules of the 110 mg presentation at 10.5 per day for 21.7 days on hand, and 263 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 9.9 per day for 26.4 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 35 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 1.7 per day for 20.3 days on hand.
The ranked alternate manufacturer option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG (FEI 3002806556) has an import alert 66-66 dated 2009-09-30 and a prior OAI inspection ending 2012-11-12, with the most recent VAI inspection ending 2025-05-15.

Bidachem S.p.A. (FEI 3002806598) shows VAI inspections ending 2018-11-23 and 2024-05-17, and Sixarp, LLC (FEI 1000115322) shows a VAI inspection ending 2010-05-28 and a NAI inspection dated 2025-03-06.
